title: For P200k monthy pay? Immigration intercepts 3 Filipinos allegedly recruited as border guards in Europe
summary: Three Filipino men were intercepted by the Bureau of Immigration in Davao City after discovering that they were being recruited to work as soldiers or border guards in Europe for a monthly salary of…

blocks.text: Three Filipino men were intercepted by the Bureau of Immigration in Davao City after discovering that they were being recruited to work as soldiers or border guards in Europe for a monthly salary of P200,000, the agency said Monday.
